index.faq.01: FAQ: the questions we hear most.
index.faq.03: We build websites, CRMs and custom software, automations and AI assistants. We started in real estate and now work with other sectors too.
index.faq.04: Do you only work with real estate agencies?
index.faq.05: No. Real estate is where we started, but we do the same for clinics, restaurants, law firms, shops, gyms and other businesses. Take a look at the solutions for your sector.
index.faq.06: How long does it take to build a website?
index.faq.07: Usually 2 to 3 weeks. The final timeline depends on the size of the project and the services included, and quality always comes before speed.
index.faq.08: And a custom CRM or piece of software?
index.faq.09: It depends on the features and integrations you need. The proposal always includes a fixed timeline, agreed before we start. [TO CONFIRM: typical timeline]
index.faq.10: What do the automations and the AI assistant do?
index.faq.11: Automations take care of what is done by hand today: replying to new enquiries, sending reminders, reactivating past clients and creating listings. The AI assistant answers your clients at any hour, on your website or on WhatsApp, and passes the leads on to you already organised.
index.faq.12: Can my website be in several languages?
index.faq.13: Yes. We build every website in several languages from the ground up, and each language has its own URLs so it shows up on Google in each country.
index.faq.14: How do I receive the enquiries from my website?
index.faq.15: Every form sends the details wherever you want (our CRM, Google Sheets, Notion, HubSpot or Pipedrive) and alerts your team by WhatsApp or email at the same time. All within seconds, without losing a single lead.
index.faq.17: We stay with you, with maintenance and tweaks whenever you need them. If you prefer, you can take care of maintenance yourself, with no dependency on us. [TO CONFIRM: whether ongoing SEO and paid campaign management are still offered]
index.faq.18: How do I get a quote?
index.faq.19: Book a short, free call with us. From there, we put together a proposal tailored to your business, with the timeline and price agreed upfront.
index.faq.21: Because we know real estate from the inside and build everything to measure, with no generic templates. And you always speak directly to the people doing the work: no middlemen, no surprises.

index.flow-section.02: FORMA understood our problem. Within two weeks we had a new website live, in three languages, with international leads reaching our phone almost every day.

chat.kb.answer: Hello! How can I help? I can tell you about our services, custom CRMs, timelines or how we work.

We do four things: websites, custom software and CRMs, automations and AI assistants that answer 24/7. We started in real estate and now work with other sectors too. Would you like to know more about any of them?

We build websites from scratch: fast, multilingual and designed to turn visits into enquiries. Every form sends leads wherever you want and alerts your team. A website is usually ready in 2 to 3 weeks; the final timeline depends on the project.
Whenever those tools allow it, yes: we connect what we build to what you already use. To confirm it for your case, tell us which tools you use through the contact form.

We build CRMs from scratch, tailored to each team: contacts organised by type, pipelines, Idealista integration, automations, dashboards and team permissions. One example is FORMA CRM, which we built for a team at Century 21 Lux. See more on the FORMA CRM page.

Automations take care of what is done by hand today: replying to new enquiries in seconds, sending booking reminders, reactivating past clients, matching properties to clients and creating listings and posts from photos.

The AI assistant answers your clients at any hour, on your website or on WhatsApp, and passes the leads on to you already organised. This chat is a simple example of what you could have on your own site.
Yes. We started in real estate, but we do the same for clinics, restaurants, law firms, shops, gyms, accountants, hotels and other businesses. See examples for your sector on the solutions page.

Our most recent case is Satus: we built the website, a custom CRM and the automations that reactivate clients, match every new property with client preferences and create listings, posts and videos from photos. We also built FORMA CRM for a team at Century 21 Lux.
Pricing depends on what you need: every project gets a tailored proposal, with the timeline and price agreed before we start. To get a quote, use the contact form. The first conversation is free.

A website is usually ready in 2 to 3 weeks. For CRMs, software and automations, the timeline depends on the features and is fixed in the proposal. For the timeline in your case, get in touch through the contact form.

We work in four steps: 1. Conversation, to understand your business; 2. Proposal, a clear plan with timeline and budget; 3. Build, with progress shown every week; 4. Launch and support, where we put everything live and keep supporting you.
Yes, we build multilingual websites from the ground up, each language with its own URLs so it shows up on Google in each country. This assistant answers in Portuguese and English.
We stay with you after launch, with tweaks and support whenever you need them. If you prefer, you can take care of maintenance yourself, with no dependency on us.
Your data always belongs to you, and the CRMs we build comply with the GDPR, with individual logins and team permissions. For details on your project, get in touch through the contact form.
Yes, we work with businesses of any size. Every proposal is tailored to what you need.
You can reach us through the contact form or at forma.work@gmail.com. We reply within 24 working hours.
We are based in Lisbon, Portugal. To find out how we could work together, get in touch through the contact form.
You are welcome! When you are ready to move forward, use the contact form. The first conversation is free.
